name: shell
title: Shell
description: The frame every screen sits in — a 64px labelled module rail, the module's resizable column, a 48px top bar with fixed slots, the page, a right panel slot and a phone bottom bar — laid out in CSS before hydration by one rule: the panel docks beside the page while the page keeps its minimum width, else the column folds, else the panel slides over; with the desktop app's one title row, the cookie state script and the floating area.

meta.whenToUse: The app's frame: rail of modules, a module's column, the top bar, the page and the panel, on every width from a 320px phone to a wide desktop window, in the browser and the desktop app.
meta.whenNotToUse: Sign-in, public and marketing pages (no shell), or a region inside a page (use a grid or ResizablePanelGroup).
